title: Indian Agricultural History and Practices Overview
reason: Explains the historical and current agricultural practices in India.

tasks.task: Describe the history of agriculture in India from ancient times to the present.

subtasks.text: Observe the traces of agricultural cultivation in the Indus Valley civilization and evidence in southern India.
Note the early domestication of crops like serial shrubs fibers and animals like dogs and goats.
Describe the conventional plowing technique and its description in Vedic literature.
Highlight the cultivation of rice and cotton since the Indus Valley civilization.

tasks.task: Show how agricultural practices evolved with time.

subtasks.text: Record the introduction of sugar cane cultivation by Macedonian soldiers.
Describe the plowing patterns that originated from the Bronze Age.
Point out the use of traditional agricultural implements and their continued use today.

tasks.task: Explain the current agricultural methods practiced in India.

subtasks.text: Observe the practice of shifting cultivation (slash-and-burn) and its regional names.
Highlight the three major cropping seasons in India: ruby, kharif, and zeib.
Describe the crops sown during different seasons.

tasks.task: Describe modern agricultural practices and challenges.

subtasks.text: Note the two types of commercial farming: intensive and extensive.
Observe the mixed attitudes of farmers towards new agricultural technologies.
Point out the difficulties in adopting new technologies due to communication gaps and varied soil test results.
Highlight the literacy and economic challenges faced by farmers in rural areas.

tasks.task: Mention the government's effort to promote new agricultural technologies.

subtasks.text: Describe the government's initiatives to promote higher yield seed varieties and machinery.
Note the challenges and benefits of commercial farming.
Highlight the opportunity for sustainable farming and its impact on the economy.
